player_prompt.intro:
Yu em Player {player_id} long wanem {num_rounds}-raun bilong IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Long bek raun, yu guesim wanpela namba bitwen {min_guess} na {max_guess}.
Bihaen ol i gues, target em i (2/3)x(avarej bilong tupela gues),
na pleya husat gues em i klos bes long target, em i winim dispela raun.
Yu salim bek gues bilong yu long fomat '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Dispela fom i no stret; plis salim ol tok olsem [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Yu mas ting em i namel long {min_guess} na {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Player 0 guessed {guess0}; Player 1 guessed {guess1}. Thus the Target is: {target}.
message.round_draw: Taim em i raun, dispela bai makim olsem ol man i no winim pait.

outcome.p0_wins: Man i no gat namba em i winim planti narapela raun.
outcome.p1_wins: Man 1 i winim planti moa raun.
outcome.draw: Ol i no gat wanpela samting long dispela pait.
